violations.description: Ratings are checked separately from numerical convergence.

AcOpfResiduals.description:
Independent AC OPF checks, with units stated per family. Objective agreement
is separate from primal feasibility. Bounds are evaluated only when selected.

AcPfInitialization.description: Successful AC initialization, including any fallback from the requested start.

attempts.description: Starts attempted, including the successful one (one-based).

AcPfReport.description: The AC power flow verdict from the tellegen engine.

AcPfStartStrategy.description: Initialization that produced a converged AC power flow.

BBox.description: A longitude/latitude box; `east` may exceed 180 for a seam-crossing frame.

Bound.description: A min or max bound, e.g. the lower/upper voltage-magnitude limit.

circuit_index.description:
1-based position of this branch among its corridor's circuits
(`1..=circuits`); 1 for an HVDC link.

circuits.description:
Parallel circuits in this branch's corridor, this branch included;
every branch of a corridor carries the same count. It is the corridor
plan's count, including any synthetic reinforcement. In OpenStreetMap
mode the mapped circuits keep source `osm`, added parallels have source
`synthetic`, and `osm_ids` identifies the route for both. With
`osm.reinforce=false`, counts are the summed `circuits` tags (else
`cables / 3`) of the joined ways. An HVDC link is one row for all circuits.

BranchConstraintResult.description: A DC OPF branch's thermal constraint in the final solved program.

binding.description: An enforced bound is met to the solver's reporting tolerance.

relief_per_mw.description:
Objective decrease per additional MW of symmetric rating. Only present
for an enforced row with an economic objective.

BranchFlow.description:
Branch flows, keyed by original branch id (plus the row uid when carried, as in
[`BusScalar`]). `pf` (from-end active, MW) and `loading` (|S|/limit,
dimensionless) are present on every formulation that has flows; the reactive
and to-end legs are `None` on the DC paths.

BranchLoading.description:
Interpretation of `loading`, independent of economic binding or enforcement.
An absent rating means no known equipment limit, even if a numerical solver
fallback produced a finite utilization. Older responses omit this object.

BranchScalar.description: A branch-indexed voltage product, in squared per unit.

island.description: Index of the electrical island (0 = largest).

BusInjection.description:
A nodal net injection (MW / MVAr), keyed by original bus id (plus the row uid
when carried, as in [`BusScalar`]). Injections describe the net nodal power balance.

BusKind.description: What a bus is for, as the map shows it.

oneOf.description: A junction where a line branches, with no load or machine.

BusScalar.description:
A scalar keyed by original bus id (LMP, voltage, angle, squared magnitude).
`uid` is the bus's powerio row uid when the solved network carried one, so an
overlay can re-key on stable identity instead of the positional id.

allow_load_scale.description: Allow the loop to scale total load (off: load is data, not a knob).

max_iterations.description: Each iteration is one declared parameter step with an exact DC OPF re-solve.

CalibrationParameters.description: The declared parameter set and its current values.

branch_rating_notches.description: Branches moved up one rating notch, by uid.

rating_scale.description: Rating multiplier per line class (key = class kV), bounds `[0.8, 1.5]`.

oneOf.description: Every objective term is within tolerance.
The objective decreased but a term is still outside tolerance.
No step improved the objective; `final_objective == initial_objective`.
The DC OPF stayed infeasible through every step.
Calibration was disabled or had no DC OPF to work with.

CalibrationTargets.description:
Reference ranges the calibration objective measures against. Each range is
`[low, high]` of the published or measured statistic.

binding_fraction.description: Fraction of branches at or above the loading target in the DC OPF.

hv_share.description: Fraction of buses at the highest voltage level.

loading_target.description: Branch loading the calibration keeps the worst branch under.

set_id.description: Identifier of the reference set (`reference_stats.json` entry).

ColMeta.description: Identity and quantity metadata for one column of a [`SensitivityMatrix`].

index.description: Dense index of the element this column varies.

ConstraintResult.description:
The solved state of one [`LinearConstraint`], in request order. `value`,
`lower`, and `upper` are MW; `shadow_price` is in objective units per MW, the
same units as `lmp`.

binding.description:
`value` sits at a limit, within solver tolerance. Always true for an
equality.

branches.description: Branches in the resolved row, including flows implied by injection terms.

shadow_price.description:
The objective decrease per MW the binding limit is raised:
`-d objective / d limit`. Positive when the upper limit binds, negative
when the lower limit binds, zero when neither does. A bus's price then
differs from its island's reference bus's by `-shadow_price` times the
change in `value` per MW injected at the bus and withdrawn at that reference.
Absent when the declared objective gives prices no economic meaning, as
for `lmp`.

ConstraintTermKind.description:
The quantity a [`ConstraintTerm`] weights, as the snake_case JSON tags
`"branch_flow"`, `"bus_injection"`, and `"generator"`. Every quantity is
active power in MW.

oneOf.description:
A branch's from-end active flow, positive from its `from` bus toward its
`to` bus. Keyed like a rating edit: the 1-based branch position or the
branch uid.

A bus's net active injection: generation minus demand and shunt
conductance withdrawal, which equals the flow leaving the bus on its
branches. Keyed like a demand edit: the bus id or the bus uid.

A generator's active output. Keyed by the 1-based generator position or
the generator uid.

CostTerm.description: Which generation-cost coefficient: the quadratic `cq` or the linear `cl`.

CountryDemand.description: One country's part of a region's demand under the national basis.

area_share.description:
Share of the country's area the region covers (each part of the region
counted to the country of its nearest place); absent without an area.

code.description: Country code of the places table (Natural Earth `adm0_a3`).

listed_share.description:
Population of the country's listed places over its national
population, at most 1: the share of its peak that follows its places.

peak_mw.description: Peak demand of those places, MW.

unlisted_peak_mw.description:
Of `peak_mw`, the part of the country's unlisted demand the region
takes: in proportion to the area it covers, never beyond its share of
the country's listed population, MW.

year.description:
Year of the national figure; absent when the country has no entry and
its places drew the world average.

oneOf.description:
Explicit Pac(U) slope in MW/kV. A positive slope reduces AC input when
DC voltage rises. Format-specific droop constants require conversion.

current_direction.description: An explicit unidirectional converter constraint, independent of AC loss.

loss.description: `a + b * |I| + c * I²`, with I in kA and loss in MW.

DcFormula.description: The complete DC convention, including taps and phase shifts.

oneOf.description: Legacy Tellegen: series susceptance with shifts, ignoring taps.
MATPOWER / PowerModels DCMP: ignore resistance, include taps and shifts.
Textbook 1/x, ignoring taps and shifts.
Ignore conductance: series susceptance divided by tap, with shifts.
PowerModels DCP (PGLib DC baseline): ignore taps and shifts.

violations.description:
A converged operating point can violate ratings. Never call it feasible
solely because the nonlinear equations converged.

reference_kv.description: A potential reference, not necessarily a physical earth electrode.

DcOpfReport.description: The DC OPF verdict from the tellegen engine.

branch_loading.description: Per branch loading keyed by branch uid (the module's identity).

hvdc_as_fixed_transfer.description: HVDC rows replaced by a fixed transfer on the validation copy.

loading_histogram.description: Ten bins of width 0.1 from 0; the last bin holds loadings ≥ 0.9.

unserved_mw.description: 0 when optimal, absent when infeasible (nothing is invented).

DemandBasis.description: How the demand figure was obtained.

oneOf.description:
Each place draws its country's peak per head of the places table, from
the national demand table (`RegionContext::demand_by_country`,
`Provenance::demand_table`).

Population of the places inside the region × the stated per-capita
draw × peak factor.
The request stated the peak MW.
No place fell inside the region: a per-bus default was used.

Peak MW from the population of the places inside the region. Each place
draws its country's average load per head of the places table (the
national demand table, [`crate::demand::NationalDemand`]) times
`peak_factor`, so a whole country reproduces its national peak; a place
whose country has no entry draws the world average per person. With
`per_capita_kw`, every person of every place draws that average load
instead.
A stated peak demand in MW.

DemandTableProvenance.description: The national demand table behind a national demand basis.

areas_sha256.description:
SHA-256 of the bundled country area table the unlisted demand spreads
over.

areas_source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the admin-0 file the areas were derived from.

peak_factor.description: Peak demand as a multiple of the annual average load.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the dataset the table was derived from.

Density.description:
How many buses a region gets when `target_bus_count` is not given: per
unit area in a transmission-only grid, per megawatt of peak load in a
hierarchical one.

Device.description: Additional families whose identity must survive even where solving is unsupported.

ElementAnnotations.description: Per element annotations keyed by the same ids and uids the ingest view uses.

ElementId.description:
A source-id reference for a dense row or column, so a [`SensitivityMatrix`]
self-describes and the api serializes it without re-deriving id maps.

oneOf.description: A caller-supplied linear constraint, by its position in the request.
Generation added so an island or the system meets its reserve margin.
A tie added to join components.

End.description: Which end of a branch a flow is measured at.

EquipmentOutput.description:
Equipment JSON for consumers that can display detailed switch connectivity.
The existing Equipment struct and its constructors remain unchanged.

detailed_dc.description:
Detailed records may overlap reduced HVDC links. Count, do not duplicate
or infer a multi-terminal graph without an authoritative mapping.

ExportedCase.description:
A study state written to a target format: the serialized case text, this
output operation's diagnostics, and the format token and file extension.

FallbackFrom.description:
Why a caller reran an OSM request as a synthetic one. Written by the
caller, never read by the generator, excluded from the request hash, and
echoed in the report's provenance.

FarIslandPolicy.description: What to do with landmasses that the topology cannot join.

oneOf.description:
Drop the buses of a landmass farther than `max_interconnect_km` from
the connected system (the group of landmasses whose places hold the
most people) and say so in a warning. The default: the result is one
electrical island the engine can solve as a whole.

Keep the landmass as its own electrical island with its own reference
bus and generation. Validation runs per island.

Fidelity.description:
How closely the electrical model follows the region's data: `High` uses
population weighted loads and tight parameter spreads; `Low` spreads load
with a floor plus a random weight and widens the parameter spreads.

Fuel.description: Generator fuel families carried by the report and the fuel mix.

FuelMixBasis.description: Where a region's capacity mix came from.

oneOf.description: The request stated it.

The nameplate mix of the region's dominant subdivision
(`RegionContext::subdivision`).
The default (US) mix.

GB.description: Conductance `g` or susceptance `b`, the real/imaginary parts of an admittance.

GenDispatch.description: Generator dispatch, keyed by original generator id. `qg` is `None` on the DC paths.

bus.description: Original bus identity, allowing exact aggregation of co-located dispatch.

GenerationReport.description: Extra JSON fields without changing existing Rust report constructors.

condenser.description:
A synchronous condenser the plan placed for voltage support in a
remote pocket: no active power, reactive range only.

GroupSource.description: How a substation's members were found. The strongest rule that joined any two of its buses.

oneOf.description: A single bus that no rule joined to another.
Joined only through bus-splitting jumpers.
Joined through transformers (and possibly jumpers).
Joined by sharing a coordinate (possibly with transformers).
Declared by the source data.

pf_mw.description:
Withdrawal from the from bus; injection into the to bus. Signed input
values, including reverse transfers, not newly calculated DC results.

max_interconnect_km.description:
Landmasses whose nearest buses are closer than this are joined by an
interconnect corridor (submarine or overhead), like Sicily or the Danish
islands. source: typical AC/HVDC interconnector lengths, ENTSO-E grid map.

initialization.description: Successful AC start for this island, including fallback attempts.

anyOf.description: Newton iteration count and final infinity-norm mismatch (acpf).

Nonlinear-program diagnostics. The primal residual is Tellegen's
independent maximum P/Q balance mismatch in MW/MVAr; other residuals
are separated by family below or reported by POUNCE.

base_restoration_calls.description: Restoration entries in the original solve, even when a retry wins.

base_solver_status.description: Status before recovery; absent in older responses.

restoration_calls.description: Restoration entries in the selected solve (not the whole ladder).

total_nlp_iterations.description: Base plus every retry, including rejected attempts.

Iterations.description:
The convergence record. OPF paths carry the full interior-point trace (for the
solve-card sparkline); the AC power flow carries its Newton count and final
mismatch. Untagged: the OPF arm serializes to the same bare array the DC OPF
always returned.

LimitRound.description:
One solve of a DC OPF run under [`LimitOptions`]: the program it solved and
how the solution met the enforceable thermal limits. A run without lazy
enforcement has one round.

added.description:
Limits added for the next round: the unenforced ones the flows violate
or meet, and those loaded at or above `near_binding`.

enforced.description: Thermal limits the round's program enforced.

ipm_iterations.description: Interior-point iterations of the round's solve.

max_loading.description: The largest loading over the enforceable limits, as a fraction.

variables.description: Variables and constraint rows of the round's program.

violated.description: Enforceable limits the round's solution violated; zero on the last round.

Limits2.description: Caps that keep a request inside what a browser session can afford.

max_area_km2.description: Spherical area cap of the region, km²; positive and finite.

max_branch_factor.description: Upper bound of `branch_factor`; finite and at least 1.

max_bus_count.description:
Bus cap. A synthetic grid's count is held at it (`bus_count_capped`);
an OpenStreetMap grid drops its lowest voltage levels until it fits
(`osm_bus_count_capped`) and is refused when its highest level alone
exceeds it. A transmission-only synthetic grid sized from demand also
stops at 3,000 buses (`context::TRANSMISSION_AUTO_MAX_BUSES`); one that
reaches subtransmission is sized up to this cap.

max_osm_document_bytes.description: Maximum raw Overpass response size, in bytes.

max_osm_elements.description: Maximum Overpass elements accepted before topology construction.

LoadingBasis.description: Basis of the dimensionless branch utilization, with the rating in MW or MVA.

McEnergizedOutput.description: The full portable input and its explicitly selected source-covered islands.

equipment.description:
Includes open boundary switches touching this island. An open switch
between two excluded islands appears in both island records.

Operand.description:
What a sensitivity is taken *of*, named for the physical power quantity rather
than a formulation's internal variable. The orthogonal sub-axes (active/reactive,
from/to, voltage representation) are visible to the type system; each formulation
maps a request to its own KKT rows or returns [`SensError::Unsupported`].

The dialects fold into one vocabulary: DC `Angle` is `Voltage(Angle)`, the conic
squared magnitude `w` is `Voltage(Squared)`, the nodal price is `Price(Active)`.

oneOf.description:
Nodal-balance dual (the LMP for active power, the reactive price for
reactive), per bus.
Generator dispatch `pg` / `qg`, per generator.
Branch active/reactive flow at the from/to end, per branch.

Bus voltage in the formulation's representation (`vm` / `va` / `w` / `wr` /
`wi`), per bus.

OsmIslands.description:
Island handling for the OSM path, where real data leaves isolated
substations.

oneOf.description:
Join every component with the shortest same-voltage tie lines, tagged
`interconnect`.
Drop islands without generation and report them.
Leave islands alone; validation runs per island.

OsmOptions.description: Thresholds for mapping an Overpass document onto a grid.

clip_buffer_km.description: Infrastructure this far outside the region polygon is still kept.

cluster_radius_m.description: Substation and converter elements within this radius collapse into one site.

hvdc_snap_km.description: A DC line end within this distance of a converter snaps to it.

plant_snap_km.description: A plant within this distance of a site connects there.

reinforce.description:
Add explicitly synthetic parallel circuits and voltage support to the
mapped topology when its modelled peak demand needs them. False keeps
the mapped circuit counts; validation may then report infeasibility.

snap_km.description: A line end within this distance of a site snaps to it.

voltage_floor_kv.description:
Lines and substations below this nominal voltage are distribution and
are dropped.

copyright.description:
The Overpass answer's `osm3s.copyright` notice: the licence (ODbL) the
data was served under.

licence.description:
The SPDX identifier of the licence `copyright` names, when it is one
tellegen recognizes (`ODbL-1.0`). The notice itself stays in `copyright`.

Parameter.description:
What a sensitivity is taken *with respect to* — the parameter whose hand-derived
`dK/dp` column drives the solve.

oneOf.description: Bus active/reactive demand `pd` / `qd`, per bus.
Generation cost coefficient, per generator.
DC thermal limit `fmax` / AC-conic apparent-power `|S|` limit, per branch.
Branch series admittance `g` / `b`, per branch.
Bus shunt admittance `gs` / `bs`, per bus.
Voltage-magnitude bound right-hand side (the `w = |V|²` bound), per bus.

Generator output bound right-hand side (`pmax` / `pmin` / `qmax` / `qmin`),
per generator.
Transformer tap ratio / phase shift, per branch.
Branch switching state `sw` in `[0, 1]`, per branch.

A shift of both limits of a caller-supplied linear constraint (the
fixed value of an equality), per constraint in request order.

PlacesProvenance.description: The populated places table behind the run.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the table as loaded.

source.description:
The dataset the table was derived from (the bundled table names
GeoNames' `cities5000` dump and its licence); absent for a bare array
of rows.

PlannedHvdcLink.description: A synthetic, lossless DC link scheduled at a fixed active-power transfer.

PlanningReport.description:
The corridor and reactive plan the electrify stage made before any
validation ran: what the corridors were sized for and what was installed.

added_level_kv.description:
The highest level the plan added above the modelled ones (one of
`RegionContext::promotion_levels_kv`) because corridors at the highest
modelled level needed more than two circuits; absent when the modelled
levels sufficed or the region has no higher level in service.

angle_spread_deg.description: Widest island angle spread of the planning case (DC), degrees.

branch_target.description: Branches the requested branch factor asks for.

capacitor_mvar.description: Total capacitor rating, MVAr at 1 pu.

capacity_circuits.description:
Circuits added beyond one per corridor because the planning flow
needed them.

capped_corridors.description: Corridors at the cap whose planning flow still needs more circuits.

circuit_cap.description: Parallel circuits one corridor may hold.

converged.description: False when the plan stopped at its round or circuit cap.

dispatch.description:
The planning case: `economic_dispatch_at_peak`, the least-cost
dispatch of the generators serving peak load on a lossless network
with no limits.

filler_circuits.description: Circuits added, heaviest planned loading first, to reach the target.

max_angle_difference_deg.description:
Largest angle difference across one branch in the AC solution of the
planning case at the planned voltage profile, degrees.

max_parallel_circuits.description: Most parallel circuits on one corridor.

max_planning_loading.description: Highest circuit loading in the planning case.

overloaded_corridors.description: Corridors still above their rating in the planning case.

promoted_buses.description:
Buses raised to the next voltage level because an incident corridor
would have needed more than two circuits at the lower one.

reactor_mvar.description: Total shunt reactor rating, MVAr at 1 pu.

rounds.description:
Capacity and stiffening rounds the corridor plan ran (each one DC
power flow).

stiffening_circuits.description:
Circuits added to hold each island's angle spread within the St.
Clair stability margin (44.4°).

upsized_transformers.description:
Transformer corridors whose bank the plan enlarged (up to the rating of
the line it terminates) before adding circuits.

utilisation_target.description: Share of its rating no circuit may exceed in the planning case.

Power.description:
Active or reactive power. The orthogonal P/Q sub-axis shared by prices,
dispatch, flows, and demand.

PowerFlowStart.description:
Where the AC power flow's Newton iteration starts, as the lowercase JSON tags
`"flat"` and `"case"`. Only `acpf` iterates from a start; every other
formulation refuses `"case"`.

oneOf.description: Voltage setpoint magnitudes and every angle at its island's reference angle.

The case's stored bus voltages: each bus's magnitude and its angle
relative to its island's reference bus (star buses of three-winding transformers
where the source carries them), or a typed instance's initial point. A
stored state that does not converge falls back to the flat start.

Problem.description:
Which problem to solve. The convex/power flow solve paths, as the lowercase JSON
tags `"dcpf"`/`"dcopf"`/`"acpf"`/`"socwr"`. A plain (not internally tagged) enum
so a request that omits it defaults to [`DcOpf`](Problem::DcOpf), and `{}` is a
valid base-case DC OPF request.

The `"acopf"` tag enables full nonlinear AC OPF only when the opt-in `acopf`
feature is built. Shipping adapters do not forward that feature.

oneOf.description:
DC power flow: angles and flows at the fixed generator setpoints. No prices,
no dispatch, no sensitivity.
DC OPF: the LMP / dispatch / flow workhorse. Differentiable via the DC KKT.

AC polar Newton power flow. Voltages and nodal injections. Differentiable
via the AC Newton system.
SOCWR (Jabr) conic relaxation of AC OPF. Differentiable via the conic KKT.
Full nonlinear AC OPF through the opt-in POUNCE backend.

ProblemCaps.description:
What one formulation can do in this binary: whether it is built, the named
output blocks it populates, and (when the `sensitivity` feature is on) the
operands and parameters it supports. Any (operand, parameter) pair drawn from
the two lists is a valid sensitivity cell, so the UI takes the cross product.

blocks.description: Output blocks this formulation fills, e.g. `["lmp","va","flows","dispatch"]`.

constraints.description:
The [`ConstraintTermKind`]s this formulation accepts in
`SolveRequest.constraints`. Empty when it refuses linear constraints.

Provenance.description: Everything needed to reproduce or audit the run.

spread_sigma.description: Log-normal spread applied to per-branch reactance.

ReferenceComparison.description: One statistic beside its reference range.

Region.description:
A region to generate in: a GeoJSON `Polygon` or `MultiPolygon` geometry
(longitude, latitude pairs; the first ring of each polygon is the outer
ring, later rings are holes) and a label for reports and bus names.

RegionContext.description: The region as the generator resolved it.

area_km2.description: Spherical area of the region polygons, km².

branch_factor.description: Branches per bus the topology aims at.

demand_by_country.description:
The countries behind the demand, largest peak first (national basis
only).

demand_by_subdivision.description:
Places of subdivisions with their own demand table draw it instead of
their country's.

frame.description: Continuous longitude frame of the region.

places_snapped.description:
Places counted in the region although just outside its polygons:
within 15 km of its edge, of a country whose place population it
holds at least half of, and moved onto that edge (harbours and
estuaries the polygons leave out).

population_in_region.description: Sum of `pop_max` over the populated places inside the region.

promotion_levels_kv.description:
Higher AC levels the corridor plan may raise buses to, kV, highest
first: those in service in the region above the levels modelled, from
its own ladder, whether the levels are its own or stated. Empty when
there is none, as in most of Europe and in California.

subdivision.description:
The subdivision whose places carry the most demand, when the places
name one (ISO 3166-2).

voltage_classes_kv.description: The line class each level takes its per-km parameters from.

voltage_country.description:
The country whose ladder the levels are (table code), or whose missing
entry the fallback stands in for; absent for stated levels or a region
without places.

voltage_levels_kv.description:
Nominal levels, highest first; a level the corridor plan added above
them (`PlanningReport::added_level_kv`) comes first once it ran.

RowMeta.description: Identity and quantity metadata for one row of a [`SensitivityMatrix`].

index.description: Dense index of the element this row reports.

SchematicLayout.description: Columnar layout output in graph order, sized for transfer to the browser.

attachment_gap.description:
Echo of [`SchematicOptions::attachment_gap`]; attachment symbol `i` of a bus sits
`(i + 1) * attachment_gap` below it.

attachment_slots.description:
Reserved symbol slots per bus: one per distinct attachment kind, plus one when the bus has
perfectly grounded terminals.

parent.description: Display forest: parent bus (a root is its own parent), parent edge (-1 for roots), depth.

positions.description: `x, y` per bus; y grows downwards.

segments.description: `x0, y0, x1, y1` per drawn segment; a routed edge has several.

oneOf.description: Every leaf on its own row; simple and stable under edits.
Subtrees packed as close as their per-depth contours allow; much more compact.

SensitivityMatrix.description:
A self-describing sensitivity result: `values[r][c] = d(rows[r])/d(cols[c])`,
with row and column metadata naming each quantity and its source element, and the
served-unit label.

values.description:
`values[r][c] = d(operand_r)/d(parameter_c)`, in the units named by `units`. The
engine produces per-unit values; the api edge rescales to served units.

g_mw.description: At 1 pu voltage, in native power units. Positive B supplies vars.

SolveDiagnostic.description:
A finding about how the solve treated the network, such as an island left out
because nothing supplies it. `code` is stable for programs; `message` is for
people. `buses` names the original ids of the buses concerned.

code.description:
`island_deenergized`: an island with no in-service generator was left
out of the solve; its buses carry no results and its load is unserved.
The message is PowerIO's finding; for an island an HVDC line fed, it
names the lines taken out of service with the island and the power
they scheduled into it.
`island_reference_designated`: a supplied island stated no reference bus,
so the bus of its largest generator became the island's reference.
`island_extra_reference`: the AC power flow found several reference
buses in one island and kept the first as its slack; the others hold
their voltage magnitude as PV (or PQ) buses.
`BUILD.HVDC.FIXED_INJECTION`: PowerIO's statement of what the in-service
HVDC lines inject as fixed transfers at their terminal buses.
`BUILD.HVDC.TERMINAL_INACTIVE`: an in-service HVDC line has a terminal bus
outside the solve, so neither end injects; `buses` are its two terminals.
`settings_ignored`: a reopened Study could not apply some or all of the
calculation settings its saved module recorded, such as an option this
engine does not know; engine defaults stand in for what was dropped.

SolveIteration.description:
One interior-point iterate: the iteration index, the primal objective, and
the primal and dual residuals. Collected once per Clarabel iteration to draw
the convergence plot. Shape matches the frontend `SolveIteration`.

SolveResponse.description:
The formulation-agnostic solve result. A superset: every block is optional, and
each formulation fills what it produces. Powers are MW/MVAr, nodal values are
in objective units per selected power unit, angles radians, `vm` per unit, and
`w = |V|^2` per unit squared. Element ids
are the original bus/branch/generator ids, so the frontend joins straight onto
its case.

branch_constraints.description: Thermal constraint state and marginal relief, when exposed by the formulation.

branch_susceptance_formula.description: Resolved DC convention; absent for AC results and older saved responses.

constraints.description:
The request's linear constraints, in request order (dcopf). Absent when
the request stated none.

diagnostics.description:
How the solve treated the network's islands. Empty, and omitted, when
every island is supplied and referenced as stated.

formulation.description: The formulation that produced this, echoed for the client.

initialization.description: Successful AC power-flow start. Absent for other formulations and legacy results.

limit_rounds.description:
The solves a DC OPF ran under the request's `limits` (dcopf with
`limits` only).

lmp.description:
Active nodal price when the solved OPF declares a network generator
cost objective. Feasibility solves leave this absent.

lmp_q.description:
Reactive nodal price. Always `None` in this build; the field is retained for
wire-format stability.

sensitivities.description:
One self-describing matrix per requested cell, in request order. Each carries
its own row/column element ids and the served-unit label.

va.description: Voltage angle, radians (every path except socwr, which is W-space).

vm.description: Voltage magnitude, per unit (ACPF or square root of SOCWR squared magnitude).

w.description:
Squared voltage magnitude `w = |V|^2`, per unit squared (socwr). The conic
relaxation does not guarantee a globally consistent set of voltage angles.

wr.description: Real and imaginary oriented branch voltage products (SOCWR).

SolveStatus.description: A solve outcome that succeeded. A failed solve is the `Err` arm of a solve entry.

oneOf.description: An OPF reached optimality.
A power flow or local AC OPF solve reached a validated feasible point.
Deterministic generation from the region, its population and the seed.

A grid mapped from an Overpass (OpenStreetMap) document passed beside the
request; electrical parameters are modelled, not surveyed.

Stage.description: Generation stages, in order. `Calibrate` repeats once per iteration.

counts.description: Element counts and other integers the stage produced.

SubdivisionDemand.description:
One subdivision's part of a region's demand (a US state from the
subdivision table, [`crate::subnational`]).

peak_mw.description:
Peak demand of those places, MW: the subdivision's peak times the
share of its listed population inside the region.

subdivision_peak_mw.description: The subdivision's peak (average load × peak factor), MW.

key.description: Stable key: `sub:<declared id>` when declared, else `bus:<lowest bus id>`.

kv.description: Distinct positive nominal voltages of the members in kV, highest first.

name.description: The declared name, when the source gives one.

SynchronousArea.description: A generated AC area. Bus identifiers are the module's one-based bus ids.

SynthRequest.description:
The one generation request. Unknown keys are refused here and in every
nested option, so a misspelt option fails instead of taking its default.

branch_factor.description: Branches per bus, `1.0..=limits.max_branch_factor`; otherwise by density.

fuel_mix.description: Capacity shares by fuel; normalised. Empty means the default mix.

generator_count.description: Number of generating units; otherwise 16% of the buses (at least 3).

power_factor.description: Load power factor; `q = p · tan(acos pf)`.

target_bus_count.description:
Exact bus count. Otherwise a hierarchical region (levels down to
subtransmission in a subdivision with its own ladder) takes one bus
per 10 MW of peak load at high density, 15 at medium and about 28 at
low; any other region takes `density` × area, kept between 30 and
150 MW of peak load per bus.

voltage_levels_kv.description:
Nominal voltage levels, kV, highest first after resolution. Each level
keeps its own kV for the per-unit base and takes the per-km parameters
of the nearest line class. Empty (the default) takes the region's own
ladder: its dominant subdivision's where that has one, else the
national ladder of its dominant country by demand
([`crate::voltage::VoltageLadders`]). A stated list is used as given.
Either way the corridor plan may add only a higher level in service in
the region, from its own ladder (765 kV in the United States outside
California, none in most of Europe), and stated levels that reach
subtransmission in a region with a subdivision ladder keep the
hierarchical design.

TapKind.description: A transformer control: the tap ratio or the phase-shift angle.

ThreeWinding.description: Physical three-terminal device and its analysis provenance.

vmin_pu.description: Source operating voltage bounds, per unit; absent for lowered display rows.

TopologyStats.description:
Structural statistics of the generated graph (and of a reference case when
measured with the CLI).

algebraic_connectivity.description:
Second smallest Laplacian eigenvalue, by sparse power iteration; `None`
above the size cap or for an empty graph.

delaunay_edge_fraction.description: Fraction of distinct corridors that are Delaunay edges of the bus points.

hv_share.description: Fraction of buses at the highest voltage level.

mst_length_ratio.description: Total corridor length over the Euclidean minimum spanning tree length.

setting_min.description:
Degrees for phase control, ratio for voltage/reactive control; absent
for controls whose source limits have no defined units.

TxLayout.description: Columnar layout output, sized for transfer to the browser.

boxes.description: `x0, y0, x1, y1` per substation: its box.

busbars.description: `x0, y0, x1, y1` per bus: its busbar, top to bottom.

positions.description: `x, y` per bus: the middle of its busbar.

segments.description: `x0, y0, x1, y1` per drawn segment; a routed branch has several.

unit.description: Drawing units per block: the grid unit of substation interiors before tier scaling.

editable.description: False for a display-only branch synthesized by analysis lowering.

path.description:
The rendered polyline: the branch's `route` when a geographic file
carried one (already endpoint-to-endpoint in file order), else the
straight segment between the bus points.

base_kv.description: Nominal voltage in kV (0 when the source gives none).

editable.description: False for a display-only bus synthesized by analysis lowering.

uid.description:
powerio row uid when the source format carries one (GOC3 does), null
otherwise. The numeric `id` remains the edit key. The TS layer mirrors
this shape.

vmin_pu.description: Source operating voltage bounds, per unit; absent for lowered display rows.

VoltageBasis.description: Where a region's voltage levels came from.

oneOf.description: The request stated the levels.

The national ladder of the region's dominant country
(`RegionContext::voltage_country`, `Provenance::voltage_table`).

The ladder of the region's dominant subdivision
(`RegionContext::subdivision`), down to subtransmission.

The dominant country has no ladder in the table: the ENTSO-E members'
ladder for a member, else IEC 60038's standard levels (warning
`voltage_fallback`).

VoltageKind.description:
How a voltage operand is represented: polar (`Magnitude`, `Angle`) for the AC
power flow, or the W-space lift (`Squared` = `|V|²`, `ProductReal` = `Re(Vi Vj*)`,
`ProductImag` = `Im(Vi Vj*)`) for the conic relaxation.

VoltageTableProvenance.description: The voltage ladder table behind a country or fallback voltage basis.

Warning.description: A non-fatal condition the caller should show.
